identity.title: Reject unsupported future Pipeline XML schema before execution

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-017 requires future Pipeline XML meanings to fail closed instead of being silently ignored and executed as a different inspection.

state.current_summary: The existing SerializeHelper, VisionPipelineStorage, VisionPipelineExecutionPlan, and Runner admission path now apply a centralized Pipeline XML schema gate. Unversioned legacy and explicit v1 remain loadable; future/unsupported schema and unknown critical XML fail closed with original-source preservation and LoadFailed storage state, while named optional extensions/comments remain accepted.

objective.summary: Define and verify the supported Pipeline XML schema range so future required meanings cannot be silently dropped before execution, without reopening the completed Runner prevalidation or result-identity owners.
constraints: Reuse the existing SerializeHelper deserialization boundary, VisionPipelineStorage recovery state, VisionPipelineExecutionPlan, and Runner admission path.
Keep unversioned legacy XML, explicit schema v1, comments, and named optional extension content compatible.
Preserve blocked future/critical source bytes and do not overwrite or create invalid-file backups during semantic schema failure.
Keep test artifacts on D: and do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original or external systems.

criteria.text: The supported Pipeline XML range is explicit: unversioned legacy and schema version 1 load successfully.
A future or unsupported schema version and an unknown unqualified critical element/attribute are rejected before deserialization/normalization/native execution with a typed schema error.
VisionPipelineStorage preserves the blocked source bytes, records LoadFailed, avoids invalid-file backup/default overwrite, and leaves the existing load/run failure contract usable.

XML comments and named optional Extensions/urn:openvisionlab:extension content remain loadable without changing current Pipeline semantics; opaque optional content is documented as non-canonical on later model save.
VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke builds and the focused XML-schema contract pass in Debug and Release, and recipe-load/recovery plus layer-reference XML regressions pass.
Completion evidence records owner, call path, mutable-state writer, public failure contract, shortest reading order, focused checks, and the remaining runtime/UI boundary.

context.location: VisionPipelineXmlSchemaPolicy owns XML semantic inspection; SerializeHelper owns the shared Pipeline deserialization gate; VisionPipelineStorage owns persistence failure state and source-preservation behavior; VisionPipelineExecutionPlan and VisionRecipeRunner own execution admission.

raw Pipeline XML -> SerializeHelper.TryLoadFromXmlBytes/Text -> VisionPipelineXmlSchemaPolicy -> VisionPipelineStorage.Load or VisionPipelineExecutionPlan.Create -> existing Validator/Runner admission.

Existing callers and SerializeHelper.SaveXmlFile remain mutable XML writers. The schema policy is read-only; blocked semantic loads write only the existing LoadFailed persistence state and do not write the source file.

Existing TryLoad false/error-message behavior, VisionPipelineXmlSchemaException at internal execution boundaries, and VisionPipelinePersistenceStateKind.LoadFailed are reused; no new UI state or ViewModel boundary was added.

Debug/Release in-process contracts and storage/source checks were run. Opaque extension/comment canonical-save byte preservation, WPF error dialog/theme/Wide-Compact/keyboard/DPI matrix, desktop EXE monitor matrix, camera/hardware, release/publication, and Original changes remain unverified/out of scope.

artifacts.summary: Debug schema compatibility fixture XML and report.
Release schema compatibility fixture XML and report.
Focused recipe-load and layer-reference regression reports.

evidence.observation: Source review confirmed that the centralized policy treats unversioned XML as v1, allows the explicit v1 and named optional extension/comment cases, rejects future/unsupported versions and unknown critical XML, and is invoked before deserialization or execution-plan normalization. Semantic failure returns LoadFailed without backup/default replacement in VisionPipelineStorage.

The focused contract passed 7/0 in Debug and Release. It covered legacy/unversioned and explicit v1 load, optional extension/comment compatibility, future schema v2 and unknown critical element typed rejection, execution-plan blocking before normalization, and storage source-byte preservation with LoadFailed and no invalid backup.

Debug and Release VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke builds completed with 0 errors (the existing project emitted 16 nullable warnings), and recipe-load-recovery plus pipeline-layer-reference-invariant regression contracts passed.

Stable contract, current handoff, smoke dispatch, and the contract report record the supported range, fail-closed policy, owner/call path, source-preservation boundary, verification commands, and next 2D-018 boundary.

events.summary: Close 2D-017 after centralized future-schema fail-closed source review, Debug/Release compatibility contracts, storage preservation evidence, and focused XML regressions.
